'''Core News Digest''', sometimes stylized as '''''Core News Digest''''', was a news service that reported on various business and industrial news of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

Although Core News Digest was not officially part of [[Imperial HoloVision]], it nonetheless was required to publish any stories that paint the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a positive light as well as spreading only loyal sentiment, with the threat of punishment if they fail to do so.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
